usage: cli.py tune [-h] [--cfg CFG] [--prices PRICES] --out OUT [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --cfg CFG        Path to regime config
  --prices PRICES  Optional prices CSV for replay summary
  --out OUT        Output CSV path for tuning results
  --no-clobber     Fail if output file already exists.
